fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.label: Paused (true pauses all operations, false resumes)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets the paused status of the liquidity layer to ${data.status}
${accounts.user} claims the ${accounts.mint} held for them in claim account ${accounts.claimAccount}, sending it to ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}
${accounts.user} closes their empty claim account ${accounts.claimAccount} of ${data.mint} and gets its rent back
${accounts.authority} collects the ${accounts.mint} revenue of the liquidity layer into ${accounts.revenueCollectorAccount}
${accounts.signer} creates claim account ${accounts.claimAccount} of ${data.mint} for ${data.user}
${accounts.signer} sets up the liquidity layer with authority ${data.authority} and revenue collector ${data.revenueCollector}
${accounts.authority} adds protocol ${data.protocol}, creating its ${data.supplyMint} supply position and ${data.borrowMint} borrow position
${accounts.authority} adds ${accounts.mint} to the liquidity layer, creating its token reserve, interest rate model and vault
${accounts.protocol} changes its ${accounts.mint} supply on the liquidity layer by ${data.supplyAmount} and its borrowing by ${data.borrowAmount}
${accounts.authority} pauses token ${data.mint} on the liquidity layer

display.label: Pause Supply (1 pauses, empty leaves it)
Pause Borrowing (1 pauses, empty leaves it)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} pauses the supply or borrowing of protocol ${data.protocol}
${accounts.protocol} records the balance of liquidity vault ${accounts.vault} before it operates on ${data.mint}
${accounts.authority} unpauses token ${data.mint} on the liquidity layer

display.label: Unpause Supply (0 unpauses, empty leaves it)
Unpause Borrowing (0 unpauses, empty leaves it)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} unpauses the supply or borrowing of protocol ${data.protocol}
${accounts.authority} hands the authority of the liquidity layer to ${data.newAuthority}
${accounts.authority} adds or removes authorized accounts of the liquidity layer
Brings the exchange prices and borrow rate of ${data.mint} up to date
${accounts.authority} adds or removes guardians of the liquidity layer
${accounts.authority} sets the borrow rate curve of ${accounts.mint}, with one kink
${accounts.authority} sets the borrow rate curve of ${accounts.mint}, with two kinks
${accounts.authority} sets the revenue collector of the liquidity layer to ${data.revenueCollector}

display.intent: Set a token's fee and limit
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets the fee on borrowers' interest of ${accounts.mint} to ${data.tokenConfig.fee} and its maximum utilization to ${data.tokenConfig.maxUtilization}
${accounts.authority} sets the borrow mode and debt ceilings of protocol ${accounts.protocol} for ${accounts.mint}
${accounts.authority} sets which protocols guardians may pause
${accounts.authority} sets the supply mode and withdrawal limits of protocol ${accounts.protocol} for ${accounts.mint}

display.label: New Limit (raw amount; 0 allows the most, the largest value allows nothing)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets the current withdrawal limit of protocol ${data.protocol} for ${data.mint} to ${data.newLimit}

display.label: Class (0 can be paused by guardians, 1 cannot)

definedTypes.name: rateDataV1Params
docs: @notice struct to set borrow rate data for version 1

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationZero
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationZero desired borrow rate when utilization is zero. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. at utilization = 0.01% rate could still be at least 4% (rateAtUtilizationZero would be 400 then)

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationKink
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationKink borrow rate when utilization is at kink. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. when rate should be 7% at kink then rateAtUtilizationKink would be 700

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationMax
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationMax borrow rate when utilization is maximum at 100%. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. when rate should be 125% at 100% then rateAtUtilizationMax would be 12_500

definedTypes.name: rateDataV2Params
docs: @notice struct to set borrow rate data for version 2

fields.name: kink1
docs: @param kink1 first kink in borrow rate. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
utilization below kink 1 usually means slow increase in rate, once utilization is above kink 1 borrow rate increases faster

fields.name: kink2
docs: @param kink2 second kink in borrow rate. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
utilization below kink 2 usually means slow / medium increase in rate, once utilization is above kink 2 borrow rate increases fast

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationZero
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationZero desired borrow rate when utilization is zero. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. at utilization = 0.01% rate could still be at least 4% (rateAtUtilizationZero would be 400 then)

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationKink1
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationKink1 desired borrow rate when utilization is at first kink. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. when rate should be 7% at first kink then rateAtUtilizationKink would be 700

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationKink2
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationKink2 desired borrow rate when utilization is at second kink. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. when rate should be 7% at second kink then rateAtUtilizationKink would be 1_200

fields.name: rateAtUtilizationMax
docs: @param rateAtUtilizationMax desired borrow rate when utilization is maximum at 100%. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
e.g. when rate should be 125% at 100% then rateAtUtilizationMax would be 12_500

fields.name: fee
docs: @param fee charges on borrower's interest. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100

fields.name: maxUtilization
docs: set to 100% to disable and have default limit of 100% (avoiding SLOAD).

definedTypes.name: userBorrowConfig
docs: @notice struct to set user borrow & payback config

fields.name: expandPercent
docs: @param expandPercent debt limit expand percent. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
Also used to calculate rate at which debt limit should decrease (instant).

fields.name: expandDuration
docs: @param expandDuration debt limit expand duration in seconds.
used to calculate rate together with expandPercent

fields.name: baseDebtCeiling
docs: @param baseDebtCeiling base borrow limit. until here, borrow limit remains as baseDebtCeiling
(user can borrow until this point at once without stepped expansion). Above this, automated limit comes in place.
amount in raw (to be multiplied with exchange price) or normal depends on configured mode in user config for the token:
with interest -> raw, without interest -> normal

fields.name: maxDebtCeiling
docs: @param maxDebtCeiling max borrow ceiling, maximum amount the user can borrow.
amount in raw (to be multiplied with exchange price) or normal depends on configured mode in user config for the token:
with interest -> raw, without interest -> normal

definedTypes.name: userSupplyConfig
docs: @notice struct to set user supply & withdrawal config

fields.name: expandPercent
docs: @param expandPercent withdrawal limit expand percent. in 1e2: 100% = 10_000; 1% = 100
Also used to calculate rate at which withdrawal limit should decrease (instant).

fields.name: expandDuration
docs: @param expandDuration withdrawal limit expand duration in seconds.
used to calculate rate together with expandPercent

fields.name: baseWithdrawalLimit
docs: @param baseWithdrawalLimit base limit, below this, user can withdraw the entire amount.
amount in raw (to be multiplied with exchange price) or normal depends on configured mode in user config for the token:
with interest -> raw, without interest -> normal
